第一千零九十七章 丰原古战场（第1页）
丰原古战场（丰原古战场（第22页）武书并不否认道，“算是吧！”“我明白了！”紧接着，王铁蛋便是起身冲着武书拱手道，“宗主，若是没有其他安排，那……青峰巨剑剑主就此告退。”而在王铁蛋走后，朝刹、青年蜚语也是同时现身。武书没有任何犹豫道，“丰原澡地中都有什么存在，想必两位太上长老早已知道。”丰原澡地和一剑宗存在哪些渊源，一剑宗又为何会将一位剑主落子于苍源域，朝刹、蜚语还是知道这两件事情之间的背后牵连的。朝刹很不解道，“少主，只要不死神光还在，非特殊情况，最好还是不要去招惹那具古尸为好。”青年蜚语则是茅舍顿开道，“少主，难道你是打算在丰原澡地闭关修炼。”微微颔首，武书认真道，“是有此意。”正当朝刹还想极力反对什么时，青年蜚语高兴道，“执念不消，神光不灭，季丰原的这具肉身会一直在丰原澡地内那片破碎空间内游荡，实属不易。”紧接着，青年蜚语给朝刹传音道，“朝刹兄，少主刚刚不是说四大洲需要一位人族至强者站出来主持公道吗？你我只需耐心看着，必要情况下，出手帮助少主便可。”“可那是……？”可那是不死神光几个字还没全部说出来，武书便是道，“走吧？丰原澡地。”有两位太上长老协助赶路，还是很快的，武书刚迈出一步，他便已经出现在丰原澡地上空。而仅是扫了一眼身下，武书便发现了不对劲。上次来的时候，丰原澡地内的藻沼地整体偏于平整，身下的丰原澡地不仅失去了很多青绿，更是多出了很多小土丘。“少主？”在察觉到不详气息后，青年蜚语也是警惕起来。武书面不改色道，“与上次对比，丰原澡地的确是出现了不少变化。”紧接着，武书又是道，“有劳两位太上长老留在此处为本少主护法。”朝刹还是劝慰道，“少主，你真的想只身进入这片破碎的古战场？”微微颔首，武书坚定道，“还请两位太上长老相信本少主。”紧接着，武书一边将数百块刻有古大阵残纹的灵石分散出去一边放声道，“不请自来，还请诸位先辈英灵能够明白晚辈的一片苦心。”然而，数百块刻有古老阵纹的灵石同时被武书点亮后，丰原澡地下的古战场没有给出任何反应。于是，武书毫不犹豫一指点出道，“因晚辈境界低微，难以依靠强大的本源力量帮助前辈新生，但值得庆幸的是，晚辈可以依靠神性温洗……慢慢让前辈获得第二次生命。”一尘埃的气息刚在武书的指尖浮现，武书眼前的景象便是出现扭转。那身影，以灰色烟雾为袍，满脸血痕，怎么看都是到了油尽灯枯的地步，双眼中却是暗藏着燃不尽的光亮。

Chapter 1,097 Fengyuan Ancient Battlefield (Page 1)
Fengyuan Ancient Battlefield (Fengyuan Ancient Battlefield (Page 22)) Wu Shu did not deny it, "So be it!" "I understand!" Immediately afterwards, Wang Tiedan stood up and raised his hands to Wu Shu and said, "Sect Master, if there are no other arrangements, then... Qingfeng Giant Sword Master will retire." After Wang Tiedan left, Chaosha and Youth Rumor also appeared at the same time. Wu Shu said without any hesitation, "In the Fengyuan Bathhouse The two Supreme Elders must have known about the existence of Fengyuan Bathhouse and the Yi Jian Sect, and why the Yi Jian Sect placed a sword master in Cangyuan Territory. Chao Sha and Wei Yu still knew the connection behind these two things. Chao Sha said very puzzledly, "Young Master, as long as the immortal light is still there, it is best not to provoke that ancient corpse unless there are special circumstances." Rumor has it that Mao Sha suddenly said, "Young Master, are you planning to practice in seclusion at Fengyuan Bathing Place?" Nodding slightly, Wu Shu said seriously, "That's the intention." Just as Chao Sha was about to object, what else did he want to do? At that time, the young man said happily, "As long as the obsession is gone, the divine light will not be extinguished. Ji Fengyuan's physical body will continue to wander in the broken space in Fengyuan Bathing Ground. It is really not easy." Immediately afterwards, the young man said He sent a message to Chaosha, "Brother Chaosha, didn't the young master just say that the four continents need a powerful person from the human race to stand up and uphold justice? You and I just need to be patient and watch, and if necessary, help the young master." "But that is...?" But before the immortal light could say all the words, Wu Shu said, "Let's go? Fengyuan Bathhouse." There were two Supreme Elders assisting the way, and it was still very fast. As soon as Wu Shu took a step, he already appeared above Fengyuan Bathing Ground. But just by glancing under him, Wu Shu noticed something was wrong. The last time he came, the Fengyuan Bathing Ground was flat, and the Fengyuan Bathing Ground beneath him not only lost a lot of green, but also had many small hills. "Young Master?" After sensing the ominous atmosphere, Wu Shu said. Without changing his expression, he said, "Compared with last time, there have indeed been many changes in Fengyuan Bathing Ground." Immediately afterwards, Wu Shu said again, "Thank you, the two Supreme Elders, for staying here to protect this young master." Chao Sha still comforted him, "Young Master, do you really want to enter this broken ancient battlefield alone?" Nodding slightly, Wu Shu said firmly, "I also ask the two Supreme Elders to trust me." Then, Wu Shu said While scattering hundreds of spirit stones engraved with the remnants of the ancient formation, he said in a loud voice, "You are here uninvited. Please understand the painstaking efforts of this junior." However, after hundreds of spirit stones engraved with the ancient formation were illuminated by Wu Shu at the same time, there was no response from the ancient battlefield under the Fengyuan bath. So Wu Shu did not hesitate to point out, "Because this junior is of a low level, it is difficult to rely on force. The great source of power helps the seniors to be reborn, but fortunately, the juniors can rely on the divine warm washing... to slowly give the seniors a second life." As soon as the breath of dust appeared on Wu Shu's fingertips, the scene in front of Wu Shu changed. The figure was robed in gray smoke and had blood stains on his face. No matter how you looked, he looked like he was exhausted, but there was an inexhaustible light hidden in his eyes.
